architecture: One Knowledge Graph · Two Learning Paths
purpose: Audit whether semantically mapped Grade-6 KNTT rows have explicit evidence across six learning dimensions without treating skill-ID existence as full coverage.

status_semantics.SKILL_MAP: VERIFIED_SEMANTIC means all historical refs were closed by reviewed canonical skill/family/lesson-local reconciliation.
status_semantics.LEARN_CONTENT: VERIFIED_DIRECT requires direct canonical skills in a lesson-matched workspace card; PARTIAL statuses expose family/local, broad placement, shared-skill granularity, or missing direct skill.
status_semantics.MICRO_PRACTICE: VERIFIED_DIRECT requires Grade-6-tagged micro evidence for every direct skill. FAMILY_LEVEL_ONLY is not equivalent to direct lesson evidence.
status_semantics.PRACTICE_BANK: Topic-level manifests prove a bank/skill exists but not Grade-6 lesson placement; therefore no Practice status is called FULL.
status_semantics.WRITTEN_LIBRARY: Current v1 has grade_overlay/topic_id but zero kntt_placements fields, so matching exercises are candidate-only, never verified lesson coverage.
status_semantics.READINESS: Only explicit structured assessment evidence is counted. Pending academic review is not readiness coverage.

Repair by densifying existing Core cards and direct Micro; do not create new canonical skills.
